photos.desc: Skeletal restoration of Afrovenator abakensis based on the holotype and referred remains.
An Afrovenator abakensis life restoration based on Jaime Headden's skeletal.
Fastest large predator that ever lived Age: 90 million years old Height: 8 feet Length: 25 feet Origin: Morocco
A caste of a fossilised skeleton of an Afrovenator abakensis (lived 174-145 million years ago) at the Australian Museum, Darlinghurst, Sydney, New South Wales, Australia, 26 September 2024.
Photo: mounted cast of an Afrovenator abakensis skeleton at the Australian Museum, Sydney.
